comments.body: This bump the minimum go version to 1.26 so it would need to backport the go 1.26 updates to make the linter happy. And to fix the fedora-prior job we would need to bump the automation images version as well.

> This bump the minimum go version to 1.26 so it would need to backport the go 1.26 updates to make the linter happy. And to fix the fedora-prior job we would need to bump the automation images version as well.

looks like the automation process has changed (at least since the last time I touched it). What exactly is required to rebuild image on the new automation repo? cc @timcoding1988 @ashley-cui

you dont need to rebuild an image, just need to get the working one from main, i.e. https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/commit/3ef0845fb5919d140fbdab18d53dec103395e430

images are build by pushing a tag to https://github.com/podman-container-tools/automation/

you likely need to backport https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29714 as well to satisfy the linter
The top 2 commits were not clean cherrypicks. Let me know if the logformatter and other stuff should be backported here.

> Let me know if the logformatter and other stuff should be backported here.

No lets keep it small.

I don't think we want "kube: use native seccompProfile fields" in a patch release either, it is a feature so it should go into 6.2 only IMO.

Looking at the e2e logs you also need a5c304613539bacd0f26e290ff72c7e7df50a5d4 (but remove the line from test/NEW-IMAGES as we already have that in the latest image ID)
